    <AsyncImage query="Enphase IQ Battery 5P installed residential wall" aspectRatio="4:3" maxWidth="148px" shop_eligible={true}/>

    </box>

  <divider color="subtle"/>
  <row align=start gap={3}>
    <AsyncImage query="FranklinWH aPower home battery installed exterior house" aspectRatio="4:3" maxWidth="148px" shop_eligible={true}/>
    <box flex="1" gap={1}>
      **<Entity category="product" value="FranklinWH aPower 2"/>**

      15 kWh per unit. Designed for whole-home backup with intelligent energy management.
    </box>
  </row>
</box>

## How much battery capacity do you need?

| Backup requirement | Approximate storage |
|---|---:|
| Essentials: fridge, lights, Wi-Fi | 5–10 kWh |
| Essentials plus some appliances | 10–20 kWh |
| Most household loads | 20–40 kWh |
| Large home with central AC | 40–80+ kWh |

Actual runtime depends on electricity consumption and peak power requirements.

## Typical installed cost in the US

| System size | Estimated cost |
|---|---:|
| 10–15 kWh | $10,000–$18,000 |
| 20–30 kWh | $18,000–$32,000 |
| 40–60 kWh | $30,000–$55,000+ |

These are broad planning estimates before incentives, not current installer quotes. Electrical upgrades and backup configuration can change costs substantially.

{@body const [solar,setSolar] = DIL.useState("unknown")}

<box border radius="xl" padding={3} gap={3}>
  <form gap={3} onSubmit={()=>GenUI.issueNewTurn("Recommend a whole-house battery backup system. Primary goal: "+goal+". Existing solar: "+solar+". Home size: "+size+". Include sizing, system comparison and installed cost.")}>
    <box gap={1}>
      <label>Primary goal</label>
      <radio-group direction="col" value={goal} onChange={setGoal}>
        <radio value="backup">Backup power during outages</radio>
        <radio value="savings">Reduce electricity bills</radio>
        <radio value="both">Both backup and savings</radio>
      </radio-group>
    </box>
    <divider color="subtle"/>
    <box gap={1}>
      <label>Do you have solar panels?</label>
      <radio-group direction="col" value={solar} onChange={setSolar}>
        <radio value="yes">Yes</radio>
        <radio value="no">No</radio>
        <radio value="unknown">Planning or undecided</radio>
      </radio-group>
    </box>
    <box gap={1}>
      <label>Home size</label>
      <radio-group direction="col" value={size} onChange={setSize}>
        <radio value="small">Under 1,500 sq ft</radio>
        <radio value="medium">1,500–3,000 sq ft</radio>
        <radio value="large">Over 3,000 sq ft</radio>
      </radio-group>
    </box>
    <button block submit>Find the right battery system <icon name="arrow-right" inline/></button>
  </form>
</box>
